region.name: CALABARZON

indicator.name: Food-Stress Risk Score (experimental)
indicator.definition: Model score for HIGH food-insecurity risk in the target quarter (target T43, Chapter I section 1.7): regional SWS hunger (Balance Luzon) above 11.3% AND provincial food-price pressure (PSA food inflation, or food minus headline inflation, above the province's 2021-2022 60th percentile). The regional hunger part and the provincial price part are estimated separately and multiplied; the two conditions are not independent, so the product is a model score, not a tested joint probability. A food-stress risk indicator, not a measured prevalence of household food insecurity.
indicator.horizon: two-quarter-ahead forecast issued 2026-10-01 from predictors through 2026-Q3
indicator.source: SWS hunger (Balance Luzon); PSA provincial food and headline CPI and wholesale rice; typhoon tracks and ENSO; PSA production; PSA LFS (national); BSP remittances and ECB USD/PHP (national); news pipeline v3 (classifier v2, FSSI-v3); official rice-policy orders
indicator.caveat: Food-stress risk indicator from regional hunger and provincial food prices, not a measured provincial prevalence. Development evidence only (E64). Indicative decision support only.

region.derivation: Mean of 5 published province scores; the model has no region-level series.

laguna_expl.narrative: Food-insecurity risk (high regional hunger together with provincial food-price pressure) in Laguna for 2027-Q1 is forecast LOW (model score 7%: the two parts that follow, multiplied together; not a tested probability): regional hunger is likely to stay above 11.3% (96%) and provincial food-price pressure is unlikely (7%); the target needs both. Within the price part, Market / Prices lowered it and Employment lowered it. No early warning: food-price pressure 7%, HIGH-risk score 7%. Food prices in Laguna were 2.9% higher than a year earlier (latest months to 2026-08); the price condition needs more than 6.05% (this province's usual 2021-2022 level) or food prices rising faster than prices overall. Prices overall rose faster (6.9%), which this target counts as less food-price pressure, although it also means a peso buys less. Regional hunger (SWS, Balance Luzon) was 17.3% in 2026-Q2, above the 11.3% line. Slower food inflation does not mean food has become affordable; it means prices are rising more slowly. The model lowered its estimate while national unemployment rose (+0.90 points); this is a statistical pattern in a short history, not evidence that job losses reduce food stress. Some OFW Remittance figures were not yet published when the forecast was issued; the model's effect for that group partly or wholly reflects how it handles a missing figure, not an observed value. In back-tests, 2 of 10 price-pressure probabilities below 20% were followed by HIGH, so a low value can miss emerging stress; treat it as uncertain. This is an experimental forecast of a food-stress risk indicator (SWS regional hunger and PSA food prices), not a measure of household food insecurity. These are model attributions, not causes.
laguna_expl.note: This experimental forecast is a model score for HIGH food-stress risk: the regional SWS hunger rate staying above 11.3% AND food-price pressure in the province (PSA food inflation, or food minus headline inflation, above the province's usual 2021-2022 level). The two parts are estimated separately and multiplied; because they are not independent, the product is a score, not a tested probability. Hunger is measured for the whole region only, so differences between provinces come from food prices. The bars are exact SHAP values (TreeSHAP) of the food-price part, in log-odds, grouped into the five factor groups; Market / Prices also includes the projected food inflation built from PSA CPI. Each group includes its own news signals from the improved news pipeline (E60 classifier v2, articles published before the issue date, syndicated copies removed) when the model uses them; news coverage, outlet count and FSSI-v3 are left out of the bars. Employment and OFW figures are national. These are model attributions, not causes. Early warning: ALERT when HIGH risk is forecast; EMERGING when food-price pressure is likely but the hunger condition is not confirmed; model warnings for DA review, not official classifications.
